description: Probabilistic trigger sequencer: each step fires a gate only when it wins a random draw weighted by its own knob and CV

params.text: Sets the internal clock rate, 15 BPM at the bottom of its travel and 3840 BPM at the top
Sets how many steps the sequence runs for, 1 to 16
Sets the chance that this step fires a gate, never at the bottom of its travel and always at the top

inputs.text: Every volt doubles the internal clock rate
A rising edge advances the sequence, and patching anything here stops the internal clock; a gate then lasts as long as the incoming pulse stays high
Adds one step to the sequence length per volt, to a limit of 32 steps
A rising edge sends the sequence back to its first step
Adds a tenth of the chance range per volt to that step's probability

outputs.text: Carries a 10V gate while the clock is high on that step, and only when that step won its draw
Carries a 10V gate whenever a step fires, which is the eight step gates combined

notes: with more than eight steps the sequence wraps around the eight gate outputs, so step 9 fires the same output as step 1
